opportunities.title: Room Attendant
opportunities.description:
Celebrate Life, Elevated: the Southworth Way

The Company: Welcome to Southworth. We own and operate a growing portfolio of premier private clubs and communities, each offering inspired environments and locations that foster connection: to family, friends, activities, and experiences. We are proud of our âfamily companyâ roots which shape our culture of care. Our dedication to hospitality and endless activities for the entire family ensures our members experience a world at play like never before.

Whether in the heart of house or on âstageâ, our dedicated team members elevate the experience for our members, residents, guests, and fellow team members. By providing a wide array of benefits, engagement programs, unique perks, discounts, and, of course, a lot of fun, we encourage our team members to be and belong at Southworth!

The Benefits: We understand everyone has a unique set of needs: we want to support you as best we can so you can be your best self with us. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive options for medical, physical, and mental health and wellness, life insurance, paid time off, and more.

Grow with us! The sky is the limit for talented, driven individuals. With our ever-expanding portfolio, we offer opportunities to learn, grow, and thrive. We look forward to growing together.

Be YOU with us! At Southworth, we are working to redefine what it means to be a private club. We seek talent from a diverse range of backgrounds, experiences, and cultures to ensure an innovative edge. Here, diversity is a driver of our success.

About The Abaco Club: The Abaco Club is a paradise for the soul. It is an unassuming haven crafted in the pursuit of connection, happiness and belonging. Here, members unwind in barefoot luxury in island-inspired homes, golfers take on the #1 golf course in The Bahamas, and generations come together on 2 miles of uninterrupted white sands on one of the most pristine beaches on Earth.

Working at The Abaco Club means being part of a vibrant community that values your knowledge and offers opportunities for professional growth and development. Here, you can turn your passion for hospitality into a rewarding career while enjoying the stunning scenery of this beautiful place. Become a part of our team and help us show what makes the Abaco Club truly extraordinary.

The Opportunity: The Room Attendant is responsible for maintaining the cleanliness, order, and overall presentation of guest rooms, suites, and associated areas at the country club. This role ensures that all accommodations meet the clubâs high standards of comfort and hygiene, contributing directly to an outstanding member and guest experience.

Duties And Functions

  • Clean and reset guest rooms and suites, including dusting, vacuuming, making beds, and replenishing amenities.
  • Clean and disinfect bathrooms, including sinks, toilets, showers, and mirrors.
  • Replace used towels and linens with fresh, clean items.
  • Report any maintenance issues, damages, or missing items to the supervisor promptly.
  • Ensure guest rooms are stocked with proper supplies, such as toiletries, water, and club literature.
  • Handle guest belongings with care and respect privacy at all times.
  • Perform deep cleaning tasks as assigned, including carpet cleaning and high-dusting.
  • Follow all safety and sanitation protocols, including proper handling of chemicals.
  • Restock housekeeping carts and closets at the end of each shift.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and supervisors to ensure smooth operations.

Qualification Standards

  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred.
  • Previous housekeeping or hospitality experience is a plus but not required.
  • Strong attention to detail and pride in quality workmanship.
  • Ability to follow instructions and work independently.
  • Reliable, punctual, and committed to excellent service.
  • Professional appearance and respectful demeanor.
  • Must be able to lift up to 30 lbs and perform physical tasks including standing, walking, bending, and lifting for extended periods.
  • Availability to work weekends, holidays, and variable shifts as needed.

We are dedicated to providing a luxurious and comfortable stay for our members and guests. As a Room Attendant, you play a key role in upholding these standards by ensuring every room is clean, welcoming, and ready for occupancy. If you are detail-oriented, dependable, and passionate about creating a positive environment, we invite you to apply and become part of our exceptional team.

Apply today to start your new career, the Southworth Way

Note: This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of this position. It is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities, and additional tasks may be assigned based on operational needs.

We are a warm, loving family with four wonderful children ages 1,2,4 & 5 seeking an exceptional full-time live-in nanny to join our household in a safe, affluent foreign country. A respectful, supportive, and welcoming family environment.

Opportunity to live and work in a safe, affluent foreign country.

Your current resume.

opportunities.title: Director Proposal Management Defense and Space
opportunities.description:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Proposal Management to lead Defense and Space proposal operations supporting U.S. Government, OEM Defense, International Defense, and Space customers. This senior leadership role is responsible for driving winning proposal strategies, leading high-performing teams, improving proposal processes, and ensuring successful execution of complex RFQ, RFI, and RFP opportunities.

The ideal candidate is a transformational leader with deep expertise in proposal management, government contracting, cross-functional collaboration, and process improvement. This individual will work closely with executive leadership, sales, engineering, finance, and operations teams to secure new business and retain existing customers.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a diverse team of proposal management professionals.
  • Conduct performance evaluations, coaching, and career development planning.
  • Establish performance metrics and productivity goals.
  • Develop succession plans and build organizational capability for future growth.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Process Improvement & Operations Excellence

  • Identify and implement process improvement initiatives to increase proposal quality, efficiency, and responsiveness.
  • Leverage automation and emerging technologies, including generative AI, to improve proposal operations.
  • Monitor key operational metrics and present results to executive leadership.
  • Improve proposal turnaround times and on-time delivery performance.
  • Lead continuous improvement efforts using Lean and Six Sigma methodologies.

Strategic Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales, Engineering, Finance, Contracts, and Program Management teams to develop compelling solutions.
  • Facilitate executive reviews, proposal kickoffs, and compliance reviews.
  • Analyze risks, opportunities, and business impacts to support strategic decision-making.
  • Present proposal performance, business insights, and organizational recommendations to senior executives.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of proposal management experience in Aerospace, Defense, Government Contracting, or related industries.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience managing professional teams.
  • Strong understanding of RFQ, RFI, and RFP processes.
  • Knowledge of FAR and government proposal compliance requirements.
  • Experience leading cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams.
  • Proven success managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office proficiency.
  • Strong presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelorâs Degree, Management, Operations, or related field
  • APMP membership or certification.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt certification.
  • Experience with Salesforce.com and data analytics tools.
  • Experience implementing process automation and AI-enabled business solutions.
  • Background supporting Defense, Aerospace, Aviation, or Space customers.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic Leadership
  • Proposal Management
  • Project Management
  • Business Process Improvement
  • Executive Communication
  • Relationship Building
  • Data-Driven Decision Making
  • Planning & Scheduling
  • Risk Management
  • Team Development
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Customer Focus

What Success Looks Like

  • Increased proposal win rates and business growth.
  • Improved proposal productivity, quality, and turnaround times.
  • Strong employee engagement and talent development.
  • Consistent on-time proposal delivery
  • Effective implementation of process improvements and operational efficiencies

Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status.

Benefits

Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  • Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Short-term and long-term disability coverage
  • 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
  • Employee assistance program and educational assistance
  • Parental leave and 12 paid holidays
  • Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time

Explore your benefits: https://honeywellaerospacebenefits.com/

The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space â from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board.

As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com

Control Systems develops the thermal and motion control systems that help aircraft take off, land safely and protect the people on board. With more than 10 million passengers per day flying on aircraft equipped with our products and more than 75% of commercial flights beginning with our engine start systems, Control Systems reaches farther across the aviation industry than most people realize.
